summary: Split an even rectangular input into equal top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right quadrants. For every local cell, start with the top-left value and replace it with each nonzero value encountered in bottom-right, bottom-left, then top-right order. The output is the half-height by half-width grid, so the effective priority is top-right over bottom-left over bottom-right over top-left over zero.
